title: How Police Took Down Man Flashing Knife At The Store
description:
On a cool January morning, Ohio officers were dispatched to a supermarket in reference to a male brandishing a knife. The suspect was reportedly breaking things and walking back and forth near the checkout threatening patrons with the knife. The officers had the suspect surrounded and they were waiting for the right opportunity to strike. Let's see if everything goes as they planned. According to the reports, the male tried to buy socks from the self checkout machine but became enraged when the machine wouldn’t accept his 10$ bill. He punched through the screen of the machine and began breaking other items. The male was charged with vandalism, inducing panic and resisting arrest. He pleaded no contest to one count of inducing panic in the Municipal Court and the felony charges were dismissed.
